items.shadow_impact: The initial emission tranche remains orphaned on the GaugeManager contract balance and is lost forever, even after voting begins.
items.reason: Report states 'the emission sits on the contract balance, index never increments, and that tranche is lost forever even after voting begins'; claim effects encode totalWeight==0 AND NOT(emission_indexed AND NOT emission_orphaned_on_balance), which expresses the orphaned-on-balance outcome.

items.shadow_impact: The reward pool is permanently shrunk by the orphaned initial emissions.
items.reason: Report states 'This permanently shrinks the reward pool'; claim effects encode totalWeight==0 AND NOT(emission_indexed AND NOT reward_pool_shrunk), capturing the shrunk-pool outcome.

items.shadow_impact: Accounting assumptions that minted tokens will flow into gauges are broken.
items.reason: Report states 'breaks accounting assumptions that minted tokens will flow into gauges'; claim effects encode totalWeight==0 AND NOT minted_tokens_accounted_in_index, expressing the broken-accounting outcome.

items.shadow_impact: index is not incremented because the update is gated on totalWeight > 0.
items.reason: This is a mechanism, not a harm; it is captured as the root-cause statement index_update_guarded and reflected in the precondition/effect structure of all three claims, so no separate harm claim is required.
